d: Short, ash-blonde hair is styled in a bob with long bangs and a single prominent strand curving over the forehead, accented by a red ribbon tied in the back. Golden-brown eyes have a determined, wide expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is curvaceous with a large bust. The outfit consists of a metallic gold breastplate, brown leather wraps on the arms, and a fur-lined collar, complemented by a large dark grey battle axe resting on the shoulder.
